source_snapshot.items: GFX Poison Consumption Handling with CRC Write
source_snapshot.procedure: Clear logs, inject sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 2 -t 8 -m5, fetch/decode an OOB CPER attachment through raw Redfish/copy steps, and run sudo amdgpuras -C.
source_snapshot.criteria: The intended OAM has UMC/ext15/End-to-end ECC/Deferred evidence and GC/ext62/GfxGcError/Uncorrected poison-consumed evidence, with matching in-band OAM/severity.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL/generic; names the tool and risk but asks for a command already in the source and omits m5, ext15, ext62 and the two-layer oracle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; retained Pending for the CRC-write mapping, record count/order, access and recovery.

old_problem: The prior record made exact CPER count/order an engineering decision and left the case Pending, while the source used destructive log clearing and a maximum-entry shortcut that cannot establish complete CRC-write poison evidence.
disposition_reason: The exact m5 stimulus and both acceptance matrices are already authoritative in the Master row. A safe executable review can require complete post-stimulus evidence and same-OAM correlation without guessing whether the platform emits one multi-section CPER or several entries. Runtime device binding, compatible schemas, protected access and recovery remain project prerequisites under ED-11/12/15/16/17/20/30 rather than Engineering Decision Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2086, its DeepSeek cells, GPT V2, historical record, duplicate-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2087 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00131-V003 / 46555a2c93cd14fe was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
The CRC-write selector `-m5` and UMC extension 15 distinguish this case from row 2085 ODECC/ext0 and cannot inherit that row's result.

One injection must yield attributable evidence for both poison creation/detection at UMC and consumption at GC on the same mapped OAM; the source does not authorize a universal container count or ordering rule.
Use authenticated paginated before/after manifests, retrieve every new attachment and correlate timestamps/OAM rather than accepting maximum ID or tail output.
The literal ext15 label is End-to-end ECC in this row and must not be silently changed to the row-2087 End-to-end CRC wording.
Run exactly once only after target, tool/schema, isolation, propagation stop limits and recovery are signed; keep all pre-existing evidence.
No mapping query, amdgpuras, Redfish, CPER transfer/decode, injection, reset, recovery, log clear, retry or DUT command was executed.

test_case.test_name: GFX CRC-write poison creation and consumption correlation
test_case.purpose: Demonstrate that one approved m5 GFX CRC-write poison stimulus on the selected OAM creates the required deferred UMC end-to-end-ECC report and the required uncorrected GC poison-consumed report, with OOB/in-band consistency.
required_package: Approved compatible amdgpuras and cdump_analyzer versions
Protected authenticated paginated Redfish Dump/Entries and attachment service
Bound device 0 to immutable GPU UUID/BDF/OAM and associated UMC/GC path
Approved decoder schema for UMC ext15 End-to-end ECC and GC ext62 GfxGcError
Dedicated SUT, explicit injection approval, propagation policy, console/power and rehearsed recovery
test_case.test_command: With target and recovery gates closed until approval, preserve complete topology/health and OOB/in-band CPER baselines; after point authorization execute `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 2 -t 8 -m5` once. Record full output and chronology, enumerate the complete post-stimulus CPER set, securely checksum/decode every newly attributable attachment, then capture `sudo amdgpuras -C`. Never clear logs, assume only the greatest ID, or repeat the injection.
test_case.expected_result: The approved command reports its defined success state and the same intended OAM is represented by both a UMC ext=15 End-to-end-ECC Deferred record and a GC ext=62 GfxGcError Uncorrected/Poison-consumed record across the complete new CPER evidence set. In-band output agrees and the approved health/recovery state is reached without collateral OAM events.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when one authorized m5 execution is tied to the intended immutable identity, both CRC-write-specific decoded matrices are present on that OAM, complete OOB/in-band evidence agrees, collateral review is clean and post-health meets the signed oracle. FAIL for ODECC/ext0 substitution, wrong target, missing UMC or GC layer, schema/severity mismatch, unexpected propagation or failed recovery. Missing runtime prerequisites produces BLOCKED, not PASS.
safety_gate: Keep the gate closed until identity, m5 semantics/schema, isolation, propagation boundary and recovery are approved.
Require a fresh human point approval for the single poison operation.
Do not delete or clear kernel, SEL, CPER or service history; preserve before/after manifests.
Stop without retry on collateral events, target mismatch, GPU degradation or uncertain recovery.
expected_evidence: Source identity/hash, unique variant, signed device-to-OAM map and exact tool versions
Approval plus isolation, propagation and recovery records
Full m5 command output with monotonic timestamps and health telemetry
Authenticated complete CPER entry set differences and checksummed raw/decoded new attachments
In-band correlation, collateral-event assessment, restored health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If poison reaches an unintended target, either required layer is absent, collateral records appear or the GPU/SUT degrades, preserve evidence and stop. Do not inject again or clear records; use only the approved recovery and quarantine if its exit criteria are not met.

source_conflict.reason: Complete authenticated set-difference collection supersedes clear/max-ID/+1 shortcuts, and the literal m5/ext15/ext62 matrices are retained without a guessed CPER container model.

blocked.reason: Exact stimulus and acceptance semantics are usable; target, versions, access and recovery are configurable execution inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Immutable target/OAM map, m5-capable tool and decoder versions, protected Redfish endpoint, isolation/propagation limits and signed recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; GFX CRC-WRITE POISON GATE CLOSED; NO MAPPING, AMDGPURAS, REDFISH, CPER TRANSFER/DECODE, INJECTION, RESET, RECOVERY, LOG CLEAR, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Provide and approve the runtime bindings and point authorization; reopen engineering review only if the project changes the literal ext15/ext62 oracle.

external_authorities.application: Keeps distinct CRC-write coverage, protected evidence, parameterized inputs, recovery and one-shot RAS authorization.

project_authority: GPU/RAS owner approves m5 mapping/schema; BMC owner provides protected complete CPER access; platform owner signs collateral limits and recovery; human operator authorizes the action and engineer owns verdict.
